Invalid pointer faults and nonfinite arithmetic are outside the contract. 5506f0 actor-aware query,553500 secondary query and callback951010 remain explicit services. This batch reconstructs result consumption, not terrain triangle traversal, collision response or world allocation. Normal-angle optional outputs do not overlap vector backing. RotateX supports destination==source; arbitrary partially overlapping storage is excluded. Native would otherwise index outside the intended table. Metadata labels remain offsets/role descriptions, not inferred material names. Synthetic fixtures use supplied finite geometry and flag tables; no authored command-use credit is assigned. Portable source and replay harness compiled successfully.
